description: Custom `400.html` at the served root receives custom headers from `serve.json` matched against `/400.html`. Mirrors reference's `getHeaders(.., errorPage, stats)` at `serve-handler/src/index.js:508` — the custom-page branch always invokes getHeaders, even when sendError was triggered by a path-traversal that would otherwise fail to match user rules in the fallback HTML branch. Codex review round 3 P1.
